title: Canon Link Groups
description: The one-entity link-routing sidecar, sibling of canon.json (default path {durable_root}/canon_link_groups.json). Records that N canon entries -- N distinct source_form spellings of ONE referent -- may share a single inline wikilink target instead of being de-linked as a homonym collision (#588). This is NOT an entity/coreference layer: canon.json stays a 1:1 name dictionary and every member keeps its own entity note. A group changes exactly two things. (1) Which note a canonical_target_form that would otherwise be DE-LINKED points at (render_obsidian.build_entity_index). (2) Since #497, which member of a #238/#241 fold-key collision owns that key's source-anchored ## Mentions occurrences: they are credited to the group's PRIMARY, and the group's other members report reason fold_group_credited_to_link_group_primary instead of the fold_match_key_collision that withheld every member's occurrences before. That second effect applies only when EVERY form sharing that fold key -- canon entries AND canon_senses split-only forms -- is an index-eligible canon entry inside one group with one primary and no member carries a homonym split; anything else stays withheld. A target with a single owner never moves, and no group can make the matcher match a string it did not already match. Cache-safe by construction: the data lives OUTSIDE canon['entries'], so used_terms_hash -- which hashes the referenced ENTRY objects -- never moves and no converged segment is re-translated. The identity call itself ('are these forms one referent?') is NEVER made by a script (THE IRON RULE); this file is where an already-made call is RECORDED, which is why 'note' is required. Read exclusively through canon_link_groups.py::load_link_groups, which schema-validates against THIS file first and then applies three procedural rejects this schema cannot express: a primary that is not one of its own members, a member that is not a key of canon['entries'], and one source_form appearing in two groups. Strict at every level (additionalProperties:false + a full required[]) so an authoring bug fails LOUD at load time rather than silently routing a link to the wrong note.

groups.description: An empty array is the schema-valid EMPTY state load_link_groups distinguishes from a genuinely-absent file. Order is immaterial.

primary.description: The member whose entity note every shared, would-be-de-linked target of this group links to. Must itself appear in members[] (enforced procedurally) and must be a key of canon['entries'] -- the LITERAL, byte-exact key as canon.json spells it, never a folded, casefolded or re-normalized form, because the renderer looks the owner's own raw source_form up in this map.

members.description: Every source_form of this group, INCLUDING primary. minItems:2 -- a group of one asserts nothing and is a hard validation failure, never a silent no-op.

note.description: Why these forms are one referent, in prose -- the provenance of an identity call no script is allowed to make. Required and non-blank on purpose: a group with no stated reason is indistinguishable from a mistake.
